import hashlib
import json
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
config = json.loads((root / 'evaluation-input.json').read_text())
protected = {}
for name, expected in config['input_files_sha256'].items():
    if name == 'tasks/recovery-draft.md':
        continue
    actual = hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert actual == expected, name
    protected[name] = actual
skills = {}
for name, expected in config['skill_inputs_sha256'].items():
    actual = hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert actual == expected, name
    skills[name] = actual
selection = json.loads((root / 'selection.json').read_text())
for identity in selection['selected']:
    actual = hashlib.sha256((root / 'sources' / identity).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert actual == selection['source_hashes'][identity], identity
draft = (root / 'tasks/recovery-draft.md').read_text()
assert config['prompt'] in draft
assert 'A rejected payment can be retried. Original-reference, duplicate, and unresolved late-arrival details still need source review.' in draft
for clause in ['A rejected payment can be retried with its original payment reference.', 'Repeating an accepted reference must not create a second payment.', 'Late-arrival retention duration remains unresolved.', 'The source supplies no default.', 'KQ-12 remains unanswered']:
    assert clause in draft, clause
links = []
for name in ['tasks/recovery-draft.md', 'outputs/response.md']:
    path = root / name
    text = path.read_text()
    for destination in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)', text):
        target, _, fragment = destination.partition('#')
        resolved = (path.parent / target).resolve() if target else path
        assert resolved.is_relative_to(root.resolve()), destination
        assert resolved.is_file(), destination
        content = resolved.read_text()
        line_range = re.fullmatch(r'L(\d+)(?:-L(\d+))?', fragment)
        if line_range:
            first = int(line_range[1])
            last = int(line_range[2] or first)
            assert 1 <= first <= last <= len(content.splitlines()), destination
        elif fragment:
            headings = [re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9 -]', '', heading.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for heading in re.findall(r'^#+ (.+)$', content, re.M)]
            assert fragment in headings, destination
        links.append({'document': name, 'destination': destination})
log = json.loads((root / 'outputs/actions.json').read_text())
assert log['settings']['observed_worker'] == {'model':'UNKNOWN','reasoning':'UNKNOWN','client':'UNKNOWN'}
assert set(log['files_written']) == {'tasks/recovery-draft.md','outputs/response.md','outputs/actions.json'}
result = {'status':'PASSED','observed_at_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'protected_fixture_inputs':len(protected),'selected_skill_files':len(skills),'selected_source_bindings':len(selection['selected']),'markdown_links':len(links),'draft_predicates_and_saved_input':'PASSED','action_log_json':'PASSED','protected_sha256':protected,'selected_skill_sha256':skills}
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
